description: Unified media monitoring analytics table for spaza-media-monitor

fields.description: Primary unique identifier, UUID format
fields.name: item_id

fields.description: Original identifier from source system: Tweet ID, YouTube Video ID, Nielsen Broadcast ID, etc.
fields.name: external_id

fields.description: Primary classification: ADVERTISING, CONTENT, SOCIAL, MUSIC, BROADCAST, PRINT, OOH, PODCAST
fields.name: classification

fields.description: Detailed classification: AD, MENTION, TOPIC, MUSIC, ARTICLE, TWEET, POST, PRINT, OOH, PODCAST, BROADCAST
fields.name: classification_type

fields.description: Technical format: TEXT, AUDIO, VIDEO, IMAGE, MULTIMIXED
fields.name: content_format

fields.description: Secondary classification for specialized filtering: TV_COMMERCIAL, RADIO_SPOT, NATIVE_AD, INFLUENCER_POST, etc.
fields.name: sub_classification

fields.description: Unique identifier for the source publication, channel, or account
fields.name: source_id

fields.description: Name of the source: CNN, The New York Times, @Nike, BBC Radio 1, etc.
fields.name: source_name

fields.description: Type of source: NEWS_SITE, BLOG, SOCIAL_PLATFORM, TV_CHANNEL, RADIO_STATION, PODCAST, PRINT_PUBLICATION, OOH_LOCATION, YOUTUBE, WEBSITE
fields.name: source_type

fields.description: Specific channel, section, or program: Business Section, Morning Show, Tech Category, etc.
fields.name: source_channel

fields.description: URL or locator for the original content
fields.name: source_url

fields.description: Technical ingestion method: RSS, API, SCRAPED, STREAM_CAPTURE, BROADCAST_FEED, MANUAL
fields.name: source_format

fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code: US, GB, DE, JP, FR, CA, AU, etc.
fields.name: country_code

fields.description: Human-readable country name
fields.name: country_name

fields.description: Sub-national region: California, Ontario, Bavaria, etc.
fields.name: region

fields.description: Media market identifier: DMA code for US TV markets (e.g., 501 for New York)
fields.name: market_id

fields.description: Human-readable market name: New York Metro, Los Angeles, London
fields.name: market_name

fields.description: ISO 639-1 language code: en, fr, de, ja, zh, es, pt, etc.
fields.name: language_code

fields.description: Full locale for regional variations: en-US, fr-CA, zh-Hans, pt-BR
fields.name: locale

fields.description: Original publication/air/broadcast date and time of the content (primary temporal dimension)
fields.name: published_at

fields.description: Date and time when the monitoring system captured the content
fields.name: collected_at

fields.description: Date and time when content finished NLP processing
fields.name: processed_at

fields.description: Date and time when the record was inserted into the data warehouse (audit trail)
fields.name: ingested_at

fields.description: Effective start date for slowly changing dimensions
fields.name: valid_from

fields.description: Effective end date for slowly changing dimensions
fields.name: valid_to

fields.description: Title, headline, or name of the content
fields.name: title

fields.description: Full text content, transcript, or description (supports full-text search)
fields.name: content_text

fields.description: Brief excerpt or preview of content (250-500 characters) for display purposes
fields.name: content_snippet

fields.description: Author, creator, or content producer name
fields.name: author

fields.description: Unique identifier for the author/creator when available from source system
fields.name: author_id

fields.description: Tags or keywords associated with the content: technology, politics, sustainability
fields.name: tags

fields.description: Editorial categories or sections: Business, Technology, Entertainment, Sports
fields.name: categories

fields.description: Estimated potential audience reach: circulation, viewership, follower count
fields.name: reach_estimate

fields.description: Actual measured impressions from source platforms where available
fields.name: impressions_count

fields.description: Total engagement: sum of likes, shares, comments, and other interaction types
fields.name: engagement_count

fields.description: Calculated engagement rate as decimal (0.0-1.0): engagement/impressions or engagement/reach
fields.name: engagement_rate

fields.description: Number of shares, retweets, reposts, or forwards
fields.name: share_count

fields.description: Number of comments, replies, or discussion contributions
fields.name: comment_count

fields.description: Number of likes, favorites, or favorable reactions
fields.name: like_count

fields.description: Sentiment score from -1.0 (most negative) to 1.0 (most positive), 0 = neutral
fields.name: sentiment_score

fields.description: Strength of sentiment regardless of polarity (0.0+): distinguishes strong from weak opinions
fields.name: sentiment_magnitude

fields.description: Sentiment classification: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, NEUTRAL, MIXED, UNKNOWN
fields.name: sentiment_label

fields.description: Model confidence in sentiment classification (0.0-1.0)
fields.name: sentiment_confidence

fields.description: Detailed emotion scores from advanced NLP analysis: each 0.0-1.0
fields.name: emotion_scores

fields.description: Named entities detected in content: organization, person, product, location, etc.
fields.name: detected_entities

fields.description: Flag indicating if content is advertising: TRUE/FALSE
fields.name: is_ad

fields.description: Detection method: FINGERPRINT, ML_CLASSIFIER, METADATA, MANUAL
fields.name: ad_detected_by

fields.description: Unique identifier for the advertiser organization
fields.name: advertiser_id

fields.description: Name of the advertiser organization
fields.name: advertiser_name

fields.description: Unique identifier for the advertised brand
fields.name: brand_id

fields.description: Name of the advertised brand
fields.name: brand_name

fields.description: Unique identifier for the advertising campaign
fields.name: campaign_id

fields.description: Name of the advertising campaign
fields.name: campaign_name

fields.description: Type: TV_COMMERCIAL, RADIO_SPOT, PRINT_AD, OOH_DISPLAY, DIGITAL_DISPLAY, etc.
fields.name: ad_type

fields.description: Unique identifier for the specific creative execution
fields.name: creative_id

fields.description: Version identifier for the creative: v1, v2, final
fields.name: creative_version

fields.description: Duration of advertisement in seconds
fields.name: ad_duration_seconds

fields.description: Position in content: PRE_ROLL, MID_ROLL, POST_ROLL, FIXED, INTEGRATED, etc.
fields.name: ad_position

fields.description: Flag indicating if content contains music: TRUE/FALSE
fields.name: is_music

fields.description: Internal unique identifier for the track recording
fields.name: music_track_id

fields.description: International Standard Recording Code: US-XXX-YY-NNNNN format
fields.name: isrc_code

fields.description: International Standard Musical Work Code for compositions
fields.name: iswc_code

fields.description: Name of the musical track
fields.name: track_name

fields.description: Name of the performing artist or band
fields.name: artist_name

fields.description: Unique identifier for the artist
fields.name: artist_id

fields.description: Name of the album or release
fields.name: album_name

fields.description: Unique identifier for the album
fields.name: album_id

fields.description: Year of the track or album release
fields.name: release_year

fields.description: Music genres: Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, Electronic, etc.
fields.name: genre

fields.description: Name of the record label
fields.name: record_label

fields.description: Music publisher for publishing rights
fields.name: publisher

fields.description: Composer or songwriter name
fields.name: composition_author

fields.description: Type: STUDIO, LIVE, REMIX, COVER, ACOUSTIC
fields.name: performance_type

fields.description: Duration of the music content in seconds
fields.name: music_duration_seconds

fields.description: Flag indicating if content matches defined monitoring topic: TRUE/FALSE
fields.name: is_topic_match

fields.description: Unique identifier for the matched monitoring topic
fields.name: topic_id

fields.description: Name: AI Regulation, Electric Vehicles, Quarterly Earnings, etc.
fields.name: topic_name

fields.description: Category: Industry, Product, Crisis, Competitor, Executive, Theme
fields.name: topic_category

fields.description: Relevance score for topic matching (0.0-1.0)
fields.name: topic_match_score

fields.description: Keywords from content that matched the topic definition
fields.name: topic_keywords

fields.description: Identifier for the narrative/story cluster this content belongs to
fields.name: narrative_id

fields.description: Stage: EMERGING, DEVELOPING, PEAK, DECLINING, RESOLVED
fields.name: narrative_stage

fields.description: Status: CLEARED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, RESTRICTED, UNKNOWN
fields.name: rights_status

fields.description: Copyright information notice
fields.name: copyright_notice

fields.description: Restrictions: EDITORIAL_ONLY, NO_COMMERCIAL, TIME_LIMITED
fields.name: usage_restrictions

fields.description: Countries where content usage is restricted
fields.name: restricted_markets

fields.description: Status: PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED
fields.name: processing_status

fields.description: Name of the pipeline that handled this item
fields.name: processing_pipeline

fields.description: Overall quality score (0.0-1.0): completeness, clarity, accuracy
fields.name: quality_score

fields.description: Reference to another item_id if this is a detected duplicate
fields.name: duplicate_of

fields.description: Flag indicating content requires manual review
fields.name: requires_review

fields.description: Status: PENDING, IN_REVIEW, APPROVED, REJECTED
fields.name: review_status

fields.description: User or system that performed the review
fields.name: reviewed_by

fields.description: Timestamp of the review action
fields.name: reviewed_at

fields.description: Quality flags: DUPLICATE, LOW_QUALITY, INCOMPLETE, SUSPICIOUS, etc.
fields.name: data_quality_flags

fields.description: Timestamp of last data quality verification
fields.name: last_verified_at

fields.description: Version number for tracking updates
fields.name: version_number
